detailed_description:
Realistic vertical e-commerce livestream product film, warm 3200K soft key light, crisp glossy highlights on the patent leather, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, clean commercial color grading. Throughout the video <Subject 1> delivers a Mandarin voiceover driven by the external driving audio; whenever her face is on camera, her lip movements are synchronized syllable by syllable with the driving audio (口型与驱动音频逐音节同步).
[Shot 1] A locked-off medium close-up at eye level inside <Subject 3>. <Subject 1> stands facing the camera, both hands lifting one of <Subject 2>'s pumps upright at chest height and presenting it toward the lens with a bright warm smile; the shoe's cobalt-blue patent upper, fuchsia side panel, gold crisscross strap, and clear rhinestone medallion glint under the warm light. Her mouth opens and closes in lively delivery, lips parting wide on stressed syllables, the jaw dropping gently on open vowels, and the lips closing into a bright smile between phrases, as she says, <d>[zh] 姐妹们看过来！这双蓝玫鎏光高跟鞋，质感真的绝了。</d>
[Shot 2] At 0:02.800, hard cut to a static macro close-up of <Subject 2>: the shoe opening faces the lens, its smooth cobalt-blue leather footbed filling the frame, while the peep-toe end reveals the fuchsia toe edge and the gold crisscross strap with its rhinestone medallion. <Subject 1>'s manicured hand with nude-pink French nails enters from the bottom of frame, the index finger pressing repeatedly into the soft padded footbed to demonstrate cushioning, then pinching the shoe's soft collar edge, fingers moving slowly and deliberately across the insole; the warm showroom blurs behind. <Subject 1> continues as an off-screen voiceover, <d>[zh] 大家看这漆皮，撞色亮眼，镂空金属扣非常精致；鞋垫软软的，久穿不累脚。</d>
[Shot 3] At 0:07.800, hard cut to a lower-body medium shot on the warm oak floor. Her outfit follows the reference image. the camera slowly pushes in as she stops, bends her knees, and crouches slightly, one hand resting on the peep-toe of the shoe and the other index finger pointing down at the sculptural royal-blue flared heel to show its steady base; she rises and takes one small confident step. Behind her the warm shelving unit with its amber LED strip and a glowing star decoration sits softly out of focus. <Subject 1> continues as an off-screen voiceover, <d>[zh] 上脚超显腿长！而且你们看，异形跟很稳当，走路一点都不磨脚。</d>
[Shot 4] At 0:11.800, hard cut back to the locked-off eye-level medium close-up of <Subject 1> facing the camera with a bright energetic smile. At around 0:12.3 an animated red on-screen sticker reading 限时秒杀, paired with a glowing orange shopping-cart icon, fades in at the lower-left corner. <Subject 1> points her index finger down toward the lower-left sticker, then raises the finger upward in an urging gesture; her mouth opens wide on the energetic call to action, the jaw moving crisply on each syllable, cheeks lifted in a bright smile between phrases, lip movements synchronized syllable by syllable with the driving audio, as she says, <d>[zh] 现在下单限时秒杀，左下角购物车，手慢无哦，姐妹们！</d>

overall_soundscape:
Quiet warm-room indoor tone throughout with gentle room softness; faint leather contact sounds and a subtle leather creak accompany the fingers pressing the insole in the macro close-up, and one soft muffled footstep on the wooden floor during the walking shot. The presenter's clear, bright young Mandarin voice sits up front in the mix.

non_diegetic_music:
A light, upbeat, cheerful e-commerce pop backing track around 110–120 BPM, with a bouncy synth-pluck melody and a soft four-on-the-floor beat, kept low under the voiceover and lifting slightly in energy during the final call-to-action shot.
